name: Hitozuma Un'yu Saimin NTR Ben ~Namatame Miki no Yokubou~
original_name: 人妻運輸・催眠NTR便 ～生田目美紀の欲望～
source:
He majored in psychology in college,  He uses the “results” of his research to destroy those around him,  He was kicked out of the university and became a criminal.

He decides to hide out in the dormitory of a shipping company in a country town. He is thinking of quitting the shipping company as soon as possible, 

Miki Namatame joins the company.  She becomes his delivery partner, but she is taciturn and rude to Kenichi.  He is frustrated and feels the desire to subdue Miki, so he uses his “hidden research ‘results’” hypnotic device to play with her body as he pleases. 

In the process, he learns of her hidden secrets and traumas of the past. Using this, he will be able to enjoy more and more. Thus begins a day of hypnosis and pleasure.  But the end result is something even Kenichi can't predict.

[From [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf002/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
他大学主修心理学，并利用研究“成果”摧毁身边的人，最终被大学开除，成了罪犯。

他决定躲进乡下某家运输公司的宿舍。他打算尽快辞去运输公司的工作。

生田美纪加入了公司，成为他的送货搭档，但她对健一沉默寡言、态度粗暴。他感到烦躁，产生了征服美纪的欲望，于是使用自己“隐藏研究成果”中的催眠装置，随意玩弄她的身体。

在这个过程中，他得知了她隐藏的秘密和过去的创伤。利用这些秘密，他能享受到越来越多的乐趣。催眠与欢愉的一天就此开始。但最终结果，连健一也无法预测。
